test_title: PYST 58: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in the brackets to fill in the blank and complete the sentence.**

The best way to motivate someone for their hard work is to ______ (criticize) them for their little accomplishments.
solution: The correct answer is **"praise."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The question is asking for an antonym of the word **"criticize."** • **"Criticize" **means to say what is bad or wrong with somebody/something. (किसी की निंदा या आलोचना करना) • **Example**: *The doctor was **criticized**__ for not sending the patient to the hospital.* • **"Praise"** is the opposite of **"criticise."** • **"Praise"** means to express approval or admiration. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु की प्रशंसा करना, उसे सराहना) __ • **Example**: *The fireman was **praised**__ for his courage.* • The correct answer is Option 3. **Correct sentence**: *The best way to motivate someone for their hard work is to __**praise**__ them for their little accomplishments.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Blame"** means to hold responsible for something negative. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ग़लती का ज़िम्‍मेदार या दोषी ठहराना) • **"Censure"** means to express severe disapproval. (अनुचित काम करने के लिए किसी की भर्त्सना करना) • **"Control"** means to have power or authority over something or someone. ((किसी पर) नियंत्रण रखना) 2f:T1003, The correct answer is **"ruffian."**
